history.description: Use when someone is deciding the shape of a table or column, not the speed of a query. Typical asks: what type should this be (enum vs varchar, how long a varchar, text vs JSON, money as numeric vs integer minor units, timestamp handling); what should the primary key be and who generates it (UUID vs serial, app-side vs DB default); how to name foreign keys; what a multi-tenant design with an org_id must get right up front; unique/partial indexes and soft-delete vs append-only; whether a migration is safe to run against a database that already holds data. Also use when reviewing a PR, diff, or migration that adds or alters tables and the reviewer wants to know if the keys, columns, and indexes are right. Applies to any engine or tool — Postgres, MySQL, Prisma, Alembic, Drizzle, Eloquent, Ecto, Flyway, raw SQL. Trigger even on small, casual, one-column questions; the user will rarely mention "conventions." Skip for slow-query tuning, N+1/ORM fetching, and database ops.
